entities.summary: Chōhō-ji is a Buddhist temple in the city of Kainan, Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. It belongs to the Tendai school of Japanese Buddhism. Its main image is a statue of Shaka Nyorai. Its main hall, pagoda and daimon are National Treasures of Japan, and its daimyō cemetery is a National Historic Site. Chōhō-ji Temple is a Buddhist temple in Asia, established in 1000. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
